hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated Pons v2 meme pools that collects protocol and creator fees on every swap via afterSwap using a return delta, batches memecoin-denominated fees and converts them to the quote currency via internal swaps, then distributes proceeds among the protocol, creator, and an optional buyback-and-lock vault.
